title: Jammu Protest: Shiv Sena Dogra Front, Rashtriya Bajrang Dal Target 'Pro-Pakistan Remarks' After Kulgam, Kishtwar Attacks

ai.summary: Protesters from Shiv Sena Dogra Front and Rashtriya Bajrang Dal staged a demonstration in Jammu demanding action against alleged pro-Pakistan remarks following terror attacks in Kulgam and Kishtwar.

facts.claim: Shiv Sena Dogra Front and Rashtriya Bajrang Dal staged a protest in Jammu
facts.quote: With security agencies investigating fresh attacks on security personnel in Jammu and Kashmir, activists of the Shiv Sena Dogra Front and Rashtriya Bajrang Dal staged a protest in Jammu, demanding action against alleged supporters of Pakistan and those accused of helping terrorist groups operate in the region.

facts.claim: Protesters demanded action against pro-Pakistan remarks
facts.quote: Protesters also demanded strict action against the people who make pro-Pakistan speeches in India.

facts.claim: The protest followed terror attacks in Kulgam and Kishtwar
facts.quote: Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir: Rashtriya Bajrang Dal stages a protest against Pakistan over the attack on CRPF personnel in Kulgam and the recovery of two SPOs' bodies in Kishtwar.

ai.background_note: The protest targets alleged pro-Pakistan remarks by National Conference leader Dr Farooq Abdullah following recent terror attacks in Jammu and Kashmir.
